model_annotation: The plot illustrates how coverage changes as the number of completions increases for four model conditions. The x-axis is labeled “Number of completions (k)” and uses a logarithmic base-2 scale with tick labels from \(2^0\) through \(2^8\) (i.e., 1 to 256). The y-axis is labeled “Coverage” on a linear scale, spanning roughly from about 0.2 up to just under 1.0, with visible major ticks at approximately 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. The blue solid line with circular markers (Llama-3B) rises from about 0.43 at \(2^0\) to about 0.92 at \(2^8\), increasing steadily with intermediate points near 0.63 at \(2^2\), ~0.78 at \(2^4\), and ~0.88 at \(2^6\). The green dotted line with triangular markers (Llama-3B + FT) increases from about 0.44 at \(2^0\) to about 0.91 at \(2^8\), with values around ~0.64 at \(2^2\), ~0.78 at \(2^4\), and ~0.89 at \(2^6\). The light-blue solid line with circular markers (Llama-1B) increases from about 0.25 at \(2^0\) to about 0.88 at \(2^8\), passing through roughly ~0.45 at \(2^2\), ~0.66 at \(2^4\), and ~0.80 at \(2^6\). The light-green solid line with triangular markers (Llama-1B + FT) rises from about 0.26 at \(2^0\) to about 0.86 at \(2^8\), with intermediate values near ~0.46 at \(2^2\), ~0.70 at \(2^4\), and ~0.82 at \(2^6\).
